game: JAX @ HOU, 2025-11-09 13:00 ET, HOU +1.5, total 37.5, roof closed (forecast not saved)

script.base: Dome slog leaning run. Market prices a near pick'em (HOU +1.5) and a low total (37.5), implied HOU 18.0 / JAX 19.5. Stroud is out, so the inferred HOU QB is Mills (only other HOU QB in the weeks 7-9 rush log, 2 carries/7 yards) behind Tytus Howard and Ed Ingram, both out. JAX is without Brian Thomas Jr. and Ezra Cleveland. Expect a close, slow game: Etienne leads a JAX run lean, Chubb and Marks split HOU carries, and neither passing game is asked to carry a shootout.
script.flip1: JAX scores first and Mills cannot answer (JAX blitzes 34% and HOU EPA/play is -0.04 when blitzed vs +0.14 when not, with two OL out). JAX then clocks it with Etienne; HOU abandon the run, so Chubb's carries die while catch-up targets go to Schultz/Collins/Hutchinson at poor efficiency. Washington's downfield shots stall if Jacksonville is ahead and running.
script.flip2: Mills manages a field-position game and HOU's defense (4.09 rush YPC, only 22 passes of 20+ yards in 8 games) keeps JAX under its number even with Pitre and Harris out. If JAX falls behind, Etienne's rushing line dies and Washington/Brown/Hunter targets spike; if HOU is the one grinding a lead, Chubb's carry count is the under's kill.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both unders lost. Chubb lost because Houston stayed close enough to hand him the 16- and 18-carry days already in the last four (61 and 56 rush yards) and Marks did not truly split the grind, so 60.5 fell on rushing alone the way 61 and 69 rush+rec already did. Etienne lost because Jacksonville was the side that led, Cleveland's backup held up, and Harris's absence turned a 4.09 YPC defense into the 4.5-plus look that 14-16 carries needs to clear 63.5 — the same path as the 84-yard game. The shared miss is treating a 1.5-point game as a slog when one early score still produces a clock-kill for whichever back is leading. That counter is real, which is why both are leans and flagged, not strong.
slip_story: One story only: 37.5 dome, both offenses capped (Mills without Stroud/Howard/Ingram; Lawrence without Thomas and Cleveland), neither back is priced at his recent carry share. Slip is Chubb rush+rec under 60.5 with Etienne rush under 63.5. They win together in the base close game; they split if either team pulls away (Chubb under needs HOU not to lead and grind; Etienne under needs JAX not to lead and grind), so this is a base-script pair, not a blowout stack. Do not add Washington, Schultz or Collins overs — those need pass volume this total does not promise. No TDs, no second market on either back, no stake.
